nodes.name: Config
nodes.notes: Central config — edit vault path and excluded paths here if structure changes

nodes.name: Read Housekeeping.md
nodes.notes: Reads Obsidian Housekeeping.md via Local REST API. Requires Obsidian Local REST API plugin + credential.

nodes.name: Parse Timestamp & Flags
nodes.notes: Parses last-run ISO timestamp and Awaiting Decision flag list from control file

nodes.name: Find Modified Files (SSH)
nodes.notes: Dataview query: all typed files modified since last run, excluding area files

nodes.name: Filter & Parse File List
nodes.notes: Parses Dataview response, strips excluded paths (Overview/, Templates/, Archive/, etc.)

nodes.name: Write Test Log Entry
nodes.notes: Writes full log file back via PUT — content is pre-built by Build Log Entry including header, new entry prepended, trimmed to 10 days

nodes.name: LLM Pass (All-in-One)
nodes.notes: Loops over all items, builds prompt, calls LM Studio, parses response, writes changed files — all in one node. No branching, no merging, no context pairing issues.
